incoming.invalidPolicy: reject candidate configuration before activation; do not dispatch with a partial or fallback policy
incoming.invalidRequestCookie: reject request before plugin dispatch; do not include raw cookie value in the error

outgoing.httpOnly: The boolean httpOnly field explicitly distinguishes HttpOnly from script-readable cookies; both use the same typed action.
outgoing.headerSerialization: Each valid cookie action becomes one Set-Cookie header; plugins cannot set Set-Cookie through the generic headers map.

security.redactionScope: Redact values in both inbound request context and outbound plugin actions; retaining cookie names is allowed only when needed for diagnostics.
security.neverReturn: Never return raw cookie values in protocol errors or transport diagnostics.
